bio.text: Michael Owen is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 70, elected in 2024.
According to the House's biographical page, Owen is a former Hillsborough County commissioner and former Port Tampa Bay commissioner.
Owen is an attorney and small business owner who lives in Apollo Beach, holds a B.A. from Saint Leo University and a J.D. from Thomas M. Cooley Law School, and was born in Houston.
